hazard: Inadequate fluid intake and output monitoring

reports.title: Mark Athias: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: The nursing home did not have sterile replacement catheters in stock, despite being aware that Mr Athias had difficulties with his catheter, which had necessitated it being replaced twice in previous weeks. The mistakes made in ordering replacements had not been detected by the managers in the nursing home.

The catheter care plan had identified the need for his fluid intake and output to be monitored. The contemporaneous records kept were, however, inadequate. This hindered any assessment of his urinary problems. The managers in the nursinq home had not noticed the inadequacy of such records.
concerns.hazard: inadequate fluid intake and output monitoring

concerns.quote: The handover record for 2 July 2021 was missing, having allegedly been overwritten. The managers in the nursing home did not appreciate this until an Adult Safeguarding Investigation was underway.

In order to ensure instructions were complied with, and without checks to ensure the contemporaneous records required to be kept were actually being maintained, there is a risk deficient record keeping could continue.

Managers of nursing homes should make checks sufficiently often to ensure the records required to be kept actually exist, and that they are preserved, so as to facilitate an analysis of trends in the medical condition of patients in the care of the nursing home
concerns.hazard: insufficient managerial checks on record keeping

reports.title: Sophia Ayuk: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: At no time during the two periods of Ms [name redacted] inpatient care was she assessed for venous thromboembolism (VTE) risk in contravention of trust policy.
Instructions given to monitor and record Ms [name redacted] food and fluid intake were not adequately followed.
concerns.hazard: inadequate monitoring of food and fluid intake
